faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) for a project-based research position in West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Assistant - Tech Support under the advertisement number IIT/SRIC/R/EAK/2026/101.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant - Tech Support position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelors degree in the appropriate discipline, with desired experience in Mechanical, Metallurgy, Physics, Chemistry, or Geology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Candidates should verify their age eligibility before submitting the online form.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Assistant - Tech Support role will receive a salary of upto 20000 as per the project norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Kharagpur recruitment is 9 October 2026. Ensure you apply prior to this date.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application fee for all categories including General, OBC, SC, ST, and Female candidates is 0 as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial application screening followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates for the final appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply link?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the official notification PDF, online application portal, and official website links in the Important Links section of this article.
